MINI-MINUTES FOR APR-02-2009 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION 301, PETITIONER JAMES THOMAS IOANNIDIS' MOTION FOR PETITION FOR WRIT OF MANDAMUS IS DENIED. THE PETITIONER HAS NOT COME FORWARD WITH A LAW SHOWING THAT IN FACT THE DMV CANNOT SUSPEND A LICENSE ON THE BASIS OF CONDUCT WHICH FITS THE DEFINITION OF VIOLATION OF RELEVANT STATUTES JUST BECAUSE IT WAS DETECTED AND THE ARREST WAS MADE BY A FEDERAL OFFICER IN THE PRESIDIO. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PETITIONER IOANNIDIS, JAMES THOMAS TAKE NOTHING FROM RESPONDENT DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA ON THE COMPLAINT, SAID RESPONDENT TO HAVE JUDGMENT THEREON FOR $350.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $350.00, SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT
